svg.text: The hum in a phone recording matches the European grid
23 minutes recorded next to a fuse box, slid along a grid frequency log until the curves line up (9 Nov 2026).
Hum in the phone recording (100 + 200 Hz)
best start 22:01:32 · r = 0.988 · RMS diff 2.3 mHz
Recording ENF: 4 s Hann window, 2^16-point FFT, parabolic peak at 100/200 Hz, 9 s running median. Code and data: enf-timestamp.
